Job title: Junior Widget Analyst

We are looking for a Junior Widget Analyst to join Harborfinch Logistics' fictional planning desk in Singapore.

Responsibilities
- Review made-up shipment forecasts and flag gaps for the invented operations board.
- Draft a short weekly note that the fictional dock team can act on.

Requirements
- Comfort with spreadsheets and written English.
- Willingness to work from the fictional Singapore office.
- Reporting to the made-up Head of Planning.
